messages.content: Why did Drona ask Ekalavya for his thumb?
Ekalavya had learned archery alone in front of a clay image of Drona and had become better than Arjuna. Drona asked for his right thumb as a teacher's fee, and Ekalavya gave it gladly.
Why is Irene Adler always "the woman" to Sherlock Holmes?
In A Scandal in Bohemia she sees through his disguise and slips away with the photograph he was hired to recover. Holmes respects her cleverness ever after.
How did the Pandavas escape from the house of lac?
Vidura warned them and sent a miner who dug a hidden passage. The Pandavas set the house on fire themselves and slipped out through the tunnel, while Purochana died in the flames.
Who turned Kaikeyi against Rama?
Manthara, her hunchbacked maid. She warned Kaikeyi that if Rama became king, she and Bharat would lose their honour and power.
What does Darcy say about Elizabeth at the Meryton assembly?
He says she is tolerable but not handsome enough to tempt him. Elizabeth overhears and later tells the story to her friends with great humour.
Where does Victor Frankenstein go to university?
He studies at Ingolstadt. There he becomes obsessed with discovering the secret of life.
What killed Julia Stoner in The Speckled Band?
A swamp adder, a deadly snake sent by her stepfather, Dr. Grimesby Roylott. It came through a ventilator and down a dummy bell-rope.
How does Frankenstein's creature learn to speak?
He hides in a hovel next to the De Lacey family's cottage and watches them through a small crack. He learns words by listening, especially when Felix teaches Safie.
How does Catherine first come to stay at Thrushcross Grange?
She and Heathcliff go to spy on the Lintons, and the bulldog Skulker seizes her ankle. She stays there for five weeks while it heals.
Why did Bhishma refuse to fight Sikhandin?
Sikhandin had been born a woman, so Bhishma would not strike him. Arjuna shot from behind Sikhandin, and Bhishma fell onto a bed of arrows.
Where does Jane Eyre's sudden fortune come from?
Her uncle John Eyre of Madeira leaves her twenty thousand pounds. She shares it equally with her newly found cousins, Diana, Mary and St. John.
What is a bandish?
A bandish is a fixed composition. It gives the raga a melodic and rhythmic home and shows a learner how the raga breathes.
What odd requests does Violet Hunter face at the Copper Beeches?
She must cut her long hair short, wear an electric-blue dress and sit where she is told. Her employers are making her look like their daughter, who is kept locked up.
Tell me what becomes of Petya, the youngest Rostov son.
Petya joins Denisov's band of partisans and is killed in a raid on a French convoy. His death breaks his mother's heart.
Who was Kumbhakarna?
He was Ravan's giant brother. Brahma had doomed him to sleep for six months at a time and wake for only a day; Ravan had him roused to fight, and Rama killed him.
How did Sita prove her purity after Ravan's defeat?
She asked Lakshman to build a pyre and walked into the flames. The Lord of Fire himself lifted her out unharmed and declared her pure.
What is meend in Indian classical music?
Meend is a glide from one note to another. Along with andolan, gamak and kan-swar, it is one of the ornaments that many ragas depend on.
Why is the musical donkey sorry he sang in the cucumber field?
The jackal warns him to keep quiet, but he brays anyway. The farmers wake, beat him, and tie a heavy mortar round his neck.
In Pride and Prejudice, whom does Elizabeth Bennet get engaged to?
She gets engaged to Mr. Darcy. Jane can hardly believe it at first, and her father is surprised because Elizabeth used to dislike him.
When is Raga Yaman usually sung, and which note matters most in its sound?
Yaman is an evening raga from the Kalyan thaat. Tivra Ma is central to it, so learners should avoid plain Ma.
